recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-13647; only revisit if a future work-group decision changes the References-page regex semantics more broadly.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I issue requesting correction of the RESTful-reference regex because the optional absolute URL prefix was missing an inner repeat and failed multi-segment bases such as http://hl7.org/fhir.
initial_application: Applied in svn revision 13365, represented by git commit 2d094716267013faf869113ad7804ef79beb6911, which changed source/references.html to allow repeated slash-delimited URL prefix segments. Grahame noted that the proposed FQDN-only hostname rule was not adopted because non-FQDN local hostnames are valid.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps the Reference type page to references, so source/references.html is in current build scope. Later same-regex decisions FHIR-17172, FHIR-14079, and FHIR-34405 refined host, anchoring, and fragment behavior without reversing the FHIR-13647 path-segment fix; the first two are already represented by current combined-branch reconciliation commits.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current regex requires a non-empty first segment after http:// or https:// and then allows zero or more additional slash-delimited segments before the resource type, which accepts representative multi-segment base URLs such as http://hl7.org/fhir/Account/123.
